description: Road Safety Camera Network - Speeding Categories Highway Cameras (Annual) is a dataset listed in Australian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Cameras Save Lives. This data shows the numbers of infringements for each speeding offence category, issued via the main highway camera systems in Victoria: CityLink, EastLink, Geelong Road, Hume, Monash (from January - March 2014 quarter onwards), Peninsula Link (from July - September 2013 quarter onwards) and the Western Ring Road. Coverage: Australia. The portal files it under the publisher Cameras Save Lives. Its tags are CityLink, EstLink, Fines, Geelong Road, Highway Camera System. It offers 13 resource(s) in XLS, XLSX. The portal shows 2026-03-28 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-3.0-AU. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-au-portal.
